encode_bytes_first.note: encode_raw tests type(item) is bytes before isinstance(item, Atomic): Atomic is an ABC with registered classes, so every isinstance call went through ABCMeta.__instancecheck__ for the most common atom. Other Atomic types (bytearray, registered classes) still take the isinstance path.

decode_no_item_rlp.note: decode() without a sedes never uses the per-item RLP lists, so the pure-Python backend now decodes those calls with _consume_item_only (the same prefix reads, checks and errors, minus the lists); and when the lists are needed, a list's own RLP is one slice of the input instead of a concatenation per item plus an insert at the front.
